categories.label: Tool execution
categories.evidence: Four execution entries report friction: two rendering timeouts, one permission failure, and one server-tool error.

surprising: Tool execution is the clearest weakness: all four relevant entries explicitly report failures, spanning rendering, browser automation, and server tools. The sample cannot determine whether the causes lie in the environment or agent behavior.

recommended.rationale: Manage long executions and verify completion after timeouts.
Audit execution history to distinguish recurring causes.
Adapt replies to the intended personal voice.

headline: Research verification: no reported friction. Tool execution: repeated failures.
strongestBasis: Research verification has the most favorable observed friction rating among eligible categories. This is a provisional comparison of reported friction, not demonstrated task success or a ranking by volume.
limitations: Results describe the supplied sample, not the model’s intelligence.
Only user requests and retrospective complaints are present; there are no observed completed outcomes.
Covered means sufficient relevant entries with no reported friction, not verified competence.
Categories with fewer than two relevant entries are Not measured.
Recommendations are relevant to observed gaps, not confirmed missing installations.
